tools.name: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities
tools.title: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities: Federal Bids & Awards
tools.registryDescription: Search U.S. federal contract opportunities (RFPs, bids, awards) from SAM.gov official data.
tools.summary: Search and monitor U.S. federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov's official daily data extract: RFPs, solicitations, sources sought and award notices.
does: Returns federal contract opportunities as clean JSON, one row per notice, from SAM.gov's official nightly public extract (not scraped).
Filters by keyword, NAICS, PSC, set-aside (small business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB), agency, state, posted date and deadline.
Keyword search is relevance-ranked and ignores the FAR/DFARS boilerplate that every defense notice repeats.
Can run on a schedule and return only notices that are new since the last run.
tools.useFor: Finding federal contracts to bid on, daily bid alerts, market research by NAICS/PSC code, and award notices (who won what, for how much).
tools.notFor: State and local bids, non-U.S. tenders, attachment downloads, or historical spending data (use USAspending.gov).
tools.price: $0.002 per opportunity returned + $0.002 per run (about $0.20 per 100 results). No SAM.gov API key needed.
tools.examplePrompt: Find open small-business cybersecurity contracts on SAM.gov with the soonest deadlines.

tools.name: US Business Entity Check
tools.title: US Business Entity Check: Verify a Company Is Real & Active
tools.registryDescription: Verify a US company is registered and active from official state registry open data.
tools.summary: Check whether a US company is registered and active, using official state business-registry open data (New York, Colorado, Oregon, Connecticut, Texas).
does: Give it company names; for each one it returns a verdict (active, inactive, status unclear, not found) and the matching registrations.
Each registration includes legal name, registry ID, entity type, status, good standing, jurisdiction, formation date and business address.
Company records only: it never returns officers, agents, owners or any other personal data.
Handles suffix and punctuation differences (Inc vs Inc., L.L.C. vs LLC) and lists similar names separately.
tools.useFor: Vendor and supplier checks before paying, KYB onboarding, lead qualification, and confirming that a company named in a contract, invoice or email actually exists.
tools.notFor: People lookups, states other than NY/CO/OR/CT/TX, credit or financial data, or a legal certificate of good standing.
tools.price: $0.004 per company found, $0.0005 per lookup with no match, + $0.0005 per run. Failed lookups are not charged.
tools.examplePrompt: Is Arrow Electronics, Inc. a real, active registered company? Which states is it registered in?
